content:
anya: Customer report: checkout showing repeated declines for 2 merchants. CVV passed but AVS="N". Customer insists address is correct, includes apt number. They attached screenshot and order id ORD-58741. Can someone triage?
liam: Can you drop the payment request id / gateway response? need the correlation id to trace.
anya: Got it — payment request id `req_0b3f9a`. Attaching gateway response from merchant: 
```
{
  "card": { "last4": "4242" },
  "avs_result": "N",
  "cvv_result": "M",
  "issuer_code": "X31",
  "acquirer": "GlobalPayX"
}
```
liam: X31 from issuer usually means address mismatch but not a straight reject code; could be normalization. Is merchant sending address in separate lines or a single field?
maria: Merchant payload shows `billing_address.line1 = "123 Main St Apt 4B"` and our normalizer splits into `line1="123 Main St" line2="Apt 4B"`. Acquirer expects single-line for their AVS mapping. I suspect the split is causing AVS lookup mismatch.
felix: That would explain CVV=M (match) but AVS=N. Merchant country is US, zip looks okay. Can we repro by sending billing_address as one line?
anya: I spun up a repro with curl using merchant's exact payload vs combined line. Repro steps in thread: 
```
# failing version (two lines)
curl -X POST https://payments.redwood.co/charge \
  -d '{"billing_address": {"line1": "123 Main St", "line2": "Apt 4B", "zip": "94107", "country": "US"}, "card": {"number": "4242424242424242", "exp": "12/26", "cvv": "123"}}' 

# working version (single line)
curl -X POST https://payments.redwood.co/charge \
  -d '{"billing_address": {"line1": "123 Main St Apt 4B", "zip": "94107", "country": "US"}, "card": {"number": "4242424242424242", "exp": "12/26", "cvv": "123"}}'
```
support-bot: New escalation ticket created: #SUP-9921 (assigned to eng-payments) :eyes:
eng-payments: Looking. Two quick asks: 1) can we get raw acquirer request/response (no PII redacted) for `req_0b3f9a`? 2) merchant integration docs link? I want to confirm expected AVS fields for GlobalPayX.
maria: PII redacted snapshot uploaded to the ticket. Merchant integration: https://merchants.example.com/globalpayx/avs (they submit `address_line1` up to 30 chars, single-line preferred).
eng-payments: Ok that confirms. Root cause: our normalizer splits apartment numbers into `line2` which then gets mapped to acquirer field `address_line2` — GlobalPayX discards line2 for AVS and only uses line1 for match.
liam: Action items: 1) short-term: patch mapping so if line2 exists we concatenate into line1 for GlobalPayX only (can be a config flag). 2) longer-term: add an integration test for line splitting. 3) notify merchants about preferred single-line formatting.
anya: Merchant notified and asked to try sending single-line as workaround. Customer confirmed one successful charge when merchant used single-line.
felix: Will open a PR for mapping change and link it to #SUP-9921. I'll include unit test and a small e2e against sandbox GlobalPayX.
eng-payments: Also note edge case: PO Box addresses — acquirer responds with AVS=Z sometimes; we'll log these separately and we shouldn't auto-decline if CVV=M and risk flags are low. Add rule to allow merchant-configurable fallback.
maria: Filing follow-up doc in support ticket with example payloads, logs, and suggested merchant message.
anya: Thanks all. Closing loop with customer. :thumbsup:
